submittedArguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a targeted local restoration of an existing Daoist Q-style hand-painted coastal map, not a new scene. Keep each lobe and silhouette, rock-water footprint, surrounding foam and turquoise water in the original locations. Do not enlarge the rock or change the coastline. Change only the described defects inside crop-local rectangle [245, 280, 1090, 830]. Preserve every pixel outside that allowed rectangle as closely as possible, especially the outer 115 pixels on every side. Away from the defects do not repaint, smooth or recolor anything. Correct the geometry and light continuity at original native detail; no blur, feather haze, resizing, perspective shift, invented content, buildings, UI, lettering or watermark. Fixed unchanged context around the repair is essential for seamless native patch insertion.
